description: Real migrated PostgreSQL: initialize a native requester ticket and a co-managed ticket; create additional named conversations and messages across existing reply roots; verify qualified ownership, exactly one default, correct FK associations and replay-safe defaults under concurrent initialization.

Real migrated PostgreSQL guard: attempt foreign ticket/store IDs, unapproved relationship scope, redacted content and expired/lapsed writes; assert denial with no rows, files or outbox side effects and no leaked private metadata.

Real migrated PostgreSQL audience matrix: native technician, both co-managed organizations, requester and unrelated principal list/read requester, Shared IT and both organizations private conversations; assert exact row/count/title/file filtering and no co-managed license requirement for native operations.

Real migrated PostgreSQL: widen a private conversation through authorized disclosure; reject unauthorized/stale confirmation; verify transfer/ownership of history and files, source protection, and that a mere edit or follow does not disclose content.

Real migrated PostgreSQL: hand back responsibility, end a relationship and exercise existing archive/export/deletion selection over conversations, private drafts, AI artifacts, lineage and files; verify each organization receives only owned/permitted data and no private public-event side effects.

Actual application: requester-only native ticket opens compact Requester by default; create two side conversations; switch, type, reload and use back/forward; verify active labels, per-author drafts, unread/Done indicators and exact message deep links.

Actual application: compare MSP, customer IT and requester/portal views on a co-managed ticket; test denied deep links and permission loss during an in-flight read; no inaccessible titles/snippets/drafts may appear or return after the switch.

Actual application: inspect option C at desktop/narrow widths, grid/entry and embedded drawer; exercise keyboard selection/dialog focus, dark/light themes and localized copy; preserve comment ordering, authorized edits/reactions and resolution markers.

Actual application All activity: mixed authorized messages show conversation labels chronologically; replying opens its source composer with a preserved draft; the aggregate view never sends to multiple conversations.

Real migrated PostgreSQL: save text-only and file drafts, restore only for the qualified author/destination, deny another author and stale revision, and prove autosave never mutates an immutable publication reservation or creates email/outbox delivery.

Real migrated PostgreSQL: stage attachments and atomically publish a message; inject incomplete upload, conflicting operation ID, concurrent exact retries and lost acknowledgment; assert one message/file set/outbox intent with recoverable draft state.

Actual application: review From, To/CC, edited body and selected files; change recipients/audience/mailbox grant before submission; require refreshed review or denial, preserve draft, and confirm one explicit publication using the reviewed intent.

Real migrated PostgreSQL and captured email transport: requester uses owner mailbox and vendor uses originating mailbox through assignment/handoff; Shared IT read/post alone cannot send; explicit delegation allows it; revoked/disabled sender and queued grant revocation prevent delivery.

Test email infrastructure: send independent requester and two vendor messages, then reply with correct provider/header artifacts; each body/file returns only to its originating conversation and correct organizational store. Assert no appended ticket history or cross-recipient broadcast.

Test email infrastructure: valid vendor reply introduces a new sender/CC; deduplicate latest reply-all and remove own routing addresses; highlight/edit additions before next send; confirm immutable old envelopes and no portal/access/follower grants.

Test email infrastructure guard: conflicting headers, wrong mailbox, forged/invalid token and ticket-number-only side replies enter protected review with no requester insertion; authorized resolution admits one chosen destination without bypassing audience or sender admission.

Real migrated PostgreSQL: replay the same provider delivery and concurrent import after partial attachment failure; verify one accepted message, one attachment set and deduplicated allowed notification effects.

Real migrated PostgreSQL with captured notifications: follow/unfollow, reassign, revoke access and receive a private vendor reply; resolve subscribers/assignee at delivery time, omit unauthorized users/public counters, link exact conversation and keep read cursors viewer-local.

Capture external/internal delivery across draft save, share preparation, AI invocation/output, internal Post and human reviewed destination Send; assert only intended human destination actions produce external delivery and AI does not spam followers.

Actual application: mark vendor Done and resolve ticket despite open external work; a substantive reply with side option off reopens only vendor, sets its unread attention and preserves parent status; verify opening another conversation does not clear that attention.

Real migrated PostgreSQL board-policy matrix: master disabled, side disabled, both enabled; inside cutoff including exact boundary, explicit/default status, and beyond cutoff; assert legacy requester/internal-technician behavior and side results including qualified follow-up audience/files/envelope.

Real migrated PostgreSQL email policy regression: automated/bounce/ack suppression and rate limiting preserve existing ordering (cutoff before suppression); suppressed side traffic cannot reopen through bundle child reply or mark requester response fulfilled.

Real migrated PostgreSQL co-managed obligations: vendor/internal/AI work never starts/satisfies/resets unrelated requester/customer/MSP SLA; a genuine board-authorized reopen uses canonical lifecycle events and correct organization clocks.

Actual application: share one vendor message as editable text and then as quote to existing Requester; select one source attachment explicitly; guard an existing destination draft; edit/review/send and verify source audience/membership unchanged.

Real migrated PostgreSQL plus email/portal projections: publish a private-source snapshot outward; verify only explicitly selected content/files are copied, source lineage is qualified and visible only to source readers, and later source edits/deletion do not rewrite the destination copy.

Actual application: prepare a share and complete-conversation synthesis into new internal and new requester-directed destinations; require name, intended audience and explicit email recipients; creation/generation sends nothing and leaves an author-private editable composer.

Real migrated PostgreSQL with captured AI request: synthesize all published permitted source messages/replies into a private requester draft, excluding deleted/redacted/unpublished content; private prompt/source metadata never enters the destination public stream or ordinary Shared IT context.

Actual application with controlled AI responses: edit a synthesis draft, receive new source content, decline then accept regeneration; simulate a late response, generation failure and cancellation; preserve edits and draft privacy, never send automatically.

AI adapter: exercise full-source input beyond a single model context using a controlled provider; verify complete bounded processing or explicit unavailable result, accurate source cursor and no silently truncated complete-summary claim.

Real migrated PostgreSQL with captured model/tool inputs: compare private and Shared IT invocations from both organizations, source narrowing and linked-resource restrictions; forbidden body/filename/snippet/citation data never reaches inference even when personally readable elsewhere.

AI adapter and real permission reads: prompt injection in source material cannot expand context/tools or trigger email/status/recipient mutations; permission/audience revocation before completion discards output and citations without reintroducing cleared UI data.

Actual application: explicitly invoke AI in private and mixed Shared IT discussion, observe attributed stored human/AI messages and source picker; provider/entitlement unavailable leaves manual conversation, selective sharing and drafts usable.

Real migrated PostgreSQL: migrate representative legacy public/internal/Shared IT roots and scheduled content with reply tokens/files/resolution markers; repeat migration and concurrent legacy writes; preserve all relationships/audiences without one named conversation per root or default broadening.

Actual application flag matrix: new conversation and side-policy UI hidden when release flag off, legacy surfaces still work and exclude side/private/AI content; direct backend/actions remain authorized and operational independently of the release flag.

Real migrated PostgreSQL failure/guard: retained data blocks destructive rollback, malformed/mixed audience metadata cannot be promoted to requester/shared visibility, and new draft/file cleanup honors existing ownership and unpublished-file boundaries.
